It did so under the old Republic, and it continues to do so under Emperor Palpatine.|Kodir of Kuhlvult|''[[Slave Ship]]''}} '''Kuat''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and one of the earliest members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was best known as the home of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. These famous [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], used to build ships for both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|circled]] the planet for thousands of kilometers. ==Description== {{Quote|Unlike other worlds, holding Kuat's ground is largely meaningless. It's holding the shipyards that matter.|Military analyst [[Dasken Hobiv]]|}} [[File:Kuat_and_neighbors.jpg|thumb|left|Kuat was located near Balmorra and Neimoidia.]] Kuat was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kuat (star)|Kuat]], located in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]] of the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to [[Raxxa]] and [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' and less than six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away from [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]],{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}} it was a [[Color/Legends|green]] terrestrial world [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] named [[Bador]] and [[Ronay]]. A day on Kuat was 20 standard hours in length, and a year lasted 322 local days. Kuat had standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and at 10,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter, it was considered a small planet. The surface of Kuat featured three continents and scattered islands, and most of the world's terrain consisted of lush forests, rolling green plains, and carefully-groomed gardens. The planet had a temperate climate with a cool, wet winter and a warm, dry summer. Hostile animal life was nonexistent on Kuat, as terraformers had stocked the planet with inoffensive herbivores such as [[drebin]], which provided compost for the world's gardens. The introduced [[Species/Legends|species]] did not overrun the planet due to short life spans and the presence of predators.
[[File:KuatDriveYards_EGTW.jpg|thumb|The Kuat Drive Yards orbital array encircled Kuat.]]
An industrial world and center of manufacturing that played a significant role in galactic shipbuilding, Kuat was the home of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], whose [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|shipyards and construction facilities]] were the most prominent feature of Kuat, encircling the planet in the shape of a large ring. Kuat was considered one of the most efficient shipyards in the galaxy, and its defenses were formidable, with protection provided by the [[Kuati Sector Forces]] and designs used for self-defense by Kuat Drive Yards. Kuat had an aristocratic government and exported luxury goods, [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], art, and food while importing electronics, machinery, and raw materials. ==History== ===Early history=== [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] settled on Kuat in a [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] expedition in [[27,500 BBY]]. An aristocracy formed on the world as wealthy families placed hereditary claims on the growing [[starshipwright]] industry, and by [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]], Kuat had built its own colonization arks and sent its Humans to [[Axum]], [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]], and [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]]. Kuat was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] power by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], when it became a [[Core Founder/Legends|founding member]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and a consortium of the wealthiest merchant families, known as [[The Ten]], eventually came to rule Kuat. ===Galactic Republic=== [[File:KuatMesas.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kuati mesas during the Old Republic era.]] The Ten allied with the goal of forming the largest and most influential shipbuilding concern in the galaxy and hired terraformers, ecologists, and animal breeders to transform Kuat, then a barren, uninhabited world, into a paradise. Over a period of 20 years, the project changed Kuat into a lush planet with an artificial ecosystem. At the same time, engineers and construction personnel began to construct the first six shipyards of what would become the Kuat Drive Yards. Kuat was located on a Republic-controlled hyperlane during the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] that occurred from roughly [[17,000 BBY]] to [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and was within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the Galactic Republic during the final years of the [[New Sith Wars]]. By the final years of the Galactic Republic, Kuat's delegates in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] were selected by the [[House Kuat|Kuat family]], who ensured that their chosen representatives always benefited Kuat Drive Yards and, by extension, the Kuat family itself.{{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}} By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}} [[Risi Lenoan]] served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of Kuat. Lenoan was later removed from office, and [[Onara Kuat]], the leading member of the Kuat family and the principal director of Kuat Drive Yards, appointed [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] as her replacement. During the [[Old Sith Wars]] and [[New Sith Wars]], Kuat's ship production facilities produced fleets of warships for the Republic. In the centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they also constructed large ships for the protection of their sector''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' and collaborated with the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], of which their ship-production company was a member, in creating even larger designs.''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|Whenever a campaign to capture Coruscant happens—and it will happen—there will be a need to silence Kuat first.|A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] official during the Clone Wars|}} Defended by three [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kuat remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the conflict, producing troopships and other war materiel for the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]], and fell within territory defended by the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army]] during the war's early campaigns in 22 BBY. Being the site of foundries and shipyards that produced a large portion of the Republic's military hardware, Kuat enjoyed economic and political benefits from the Clone Wars, and many members of Kuat's upper administrative echelons, having won the favor of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], pursued agendas that encouraged the conflict. Senator Giddean Danu was seemingly alone in opposition to the war, causing the Kuati electorate to nearly recall him from office twice.{{DB|character|giddeandanu|Danu, Giddean}} An attempt by Onara Kuat to remove Senator Danu from office failed due to the belief of other members of the Kuat family that Danu was an effective advocate for Kuat's independence. When Balmorra seceded from the Republic, Kuat abandoned its assets on the factory world, which consisted mostly of ground-based [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and heavy vehicles. By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], orbital screens had been erected around Kuat's most heavily-guarded shipyards in an effort to dissuade long-range intelligence gathering, and Kuat had attempted to infiltrate Neimoidia with modified [[Labor droid/Legends|worker droids]] equipped with concealed spyware. Early in the Confederacy of Independent Systems's [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|assault]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] later in 21 BBY, Confederacy forces were believed to be positioning to cut off possible Republic reinforcements from Kuat.{{InsiderCite|74|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition}} ===Imperial Period=== [[File:Kuat_TEA.png|thumb|250px|Kuat in the form of a globe]] When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed, Kuat was among the first worlds to be secured under Imperial control, making a smooth transition to rule under the new government. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Thichis Kuras]], a native Kuati and a member of the world's lesser nobility, governed the entire Kuat system, and Senator Giddean Danu served as Kuat's delegate to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Anton Kale]] served as the commander of Imperial forces on Kuat, having lobbied to be assigned to the world due to his passion for engineering and ship design. Under Imperial rule, the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] restricted access to Kuat and its orbital shipyards. Most of the Kuati shipyards fell under military jurisdiction and operated with varying degrees of supervision and regulation, but they were still considered to be civilian-operated in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The military buildup that occurred under the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine made the merchant houses of Kuat astonishingly wealthy and notoriously insular. A duplicate of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was built at Kuat before being rechristened ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and moved to Coruscant, the stardocks at Kuat were the primary builders of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] for the Empire, and Kuat was the site of facilities that produced [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]]. During the Imperial supervision, Kuat could only be accessed via three ports within the main [[Inner Kuat Transfer Zone|Kuat Traffic Zone]], which was along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]; a [[Kuat Passenger Port|passenger port]], a [[Kuat Freight Port|freight port]], and a [[Imperial Transfer Post|Imperial transfer post]]. Accessible to the passenger port were the systems of [[Redrish system/Legends|Redrish]], [[Drurish system/Legends|Drurish]], [[Ulion system/Legends|Ulion]], and [[Kidir system/Legends|Kidir]]. Accessible to the freight port were the systems of [[Monadin system/Legends|Monadin]], [[Renegg system/Legends|Renegg]], [[Venir system/Legends|Venir]], and [[Horthav system/Legends|Horthav]]. Information on the Imperial port was classified.''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'' In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet led by the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']] attacked the shipyards. This led to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'' over [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] rushing to protect Kuat, leaving Fresia vulnerable to a Rebel raid that resulted in the acquisition of the first [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Rebels, having recently lost much equipment in asteroid collisions (probably during the evacuation of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]), in a daring heist with inside help, stole a [[Colony Class 23669 power generator]] from [[Kuat Freight Port]].{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}} In 4 ABY, concurrent to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Alliance occupied the shipyards. In an attempt to prevent either the Alliance or the Empire from taking over, [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] attempted to blow the yards up, although he was only partially successful, the full [[Bombing of the Kuat shipyards (4 ABY)|explosion]] being halted by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].''[[Hard Merchandise]]'' The Empire soon regained control of the yards and the planet, and [[Bevel Lemelisk]] came thither to join the design team working on the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']]. A large Imperial fleet was soon garrisoned at the planet.[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] After the Battle of Endor, the Empire drastically increased security at Kuat's shipyards while loosening its control over the planet itself. Rebel operatives were active on Kuat around this time and learned that every stardock and vessel under construction had been rigged to explode in preparation for a possible scuttling of the shipyards.{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}} [[File:Star-wars-empire-at-war-forces-of-corruption-20061024035411691.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Kuat under attack during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].]] Very soon after, [[Tyber Zann]] [[Battle for the Eclipse|attacked]] the shipyards in order to steal the unfinished ''Eclipse'' and gained information about Imperial vaults from its computers. During this time, a rebel attack force led by General [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] invaded the sector chasing the retreating fleets from Endor. Zann was successful in taking the ''Eclipse'', forcing out the Rebels, and decimating the Imperial fleet guarding [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], but decided that the ''Eclipse'' would be too big of a target and left with the vault's contents.''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was the site of [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Kuat]] between [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], loyal Imperials, and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At this time, Kuat's planetary defense forces were considered roughly equal to those of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Kuat was at the time Imperial; Zsinj's forces hijacked the ''[[Razor's Kiss]]'' from the shipyards with the help of an Imperial who preferred it was in his hands than the New Republic's, but General [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] fleet prevented Zsinj from taking it out of the system.''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]'' ===New Republic and beyond=== In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Kuat was one of a remaining handful of [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]] held by the Galactic Empire. By that time, most of the Imperial warships that guarded Kuat had departed for the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]], leaving the planet dependent on its own defenses; at the time, these included the Star Dreadnought [[Aurora (Star Dreadnought)|''Aurora'']], the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] [[Event Horizon (battlecruiser)|''Event Horizon'']], ''[[Stellar Halo]]'', and [[Luminous (battlecruiser)|''Luminous'']], and more than twelve [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Taking of Kuat|captured]] Kuat in 8 ABY in a scheme conceived by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], and [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]], with Muvunc and three other Kuat Drive Yards board members, who held a majority of KDY's shares, voting in favor of Kuat's surrender to the New Republic. Hours after Kuat joined the New Republic, deep cover Imperial agents bombed the shipyard, jumped captured Imperial ships into Kuat's sun, captured senior design engineers of Kuat Drive Yards, and fled the planet in the unfinished Eclipse for the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. With the acquisition of Kuat and its subsidiary systems, the New Republic controlled three-fourths of the settled galaxy and gained access to the Kuat system's shipbuilding docks.''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' The New Republic maintained a small embassy in [[Kuat City]] and a smaller subembassy in the orbital array. Kuat was a stronghold of the New Republic during the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and was later one of the manufacturing centers targeted by Imperial [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Kuat's powerful shipbuilding capabilities served the new galactic government well. Many of the first units designed under the [[New Class Modernization Program|New Class]] program were built at Kuat. [[File:ViqiShesh-NEGTC.png|thumb|left|160px|[[Viqi Shesh]], a Kuati aristocrat who collaborated with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].]] About [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]], [[Viqi Shesh]] was elected Senator of Kuat.''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' She was added to the [[New Republic Advisory Council]] in 25 ABY, but eventually betrayed the New Republic to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Kuat hosted briefings held by [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and continued to supply warships to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]]. Following the loss of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], additional warships were dispatched to the planet to safeguard it and its extensive shipyards. After the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], Senator [[Pwoe]], who declared himself [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] with the death of [[Borsk Fey'lya]], began moving the command structure of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Force]] to Kuat, but he was expelled from the planet when the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] dismissed Pwoe. Kuat itself was eventually conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], but the Kuati returned to the planet after the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]]. During the early stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], a space station orbiting Kuat's moon [[Ronay]], [[Toryaz Station]], served as a negotiation place between [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister]] [[Aidel Saxan]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'' Later in the war, a large scale space [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] took place over the planet. Hoping to catch the Alliance off guard, the Confederation launched an attack on Kuat to gain a foothold for the assault on Coruscant. [[Nek Bwua'tu]] set a trap for the Confederation with the [[First Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|First Fleet]], [[Fourth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fourth Fleet]], [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Seventh Fleet]], [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fifth Fleet]], and the Hapan Home Fleet which proved successful until the Jedi (betraying Caedus for what he had become) left for [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The battle dragged on for over a week with both sides sustaining heavy casualties every day. When the Bothans learned of the attack on Kashyyyk by Caedus, they broke out of the battle to go to its defense. The battle was essentially a draw.''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]'' Over 100 years after the Battle of Endor, Kuat produced new warships for the [[Fel Empire]] and later the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' By [[137 ABY]], Kuat was within the [[Core Worlds Security Zone]], a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by Krayt's empire. ==Locations== [[File:Kuat_EaW.jpg|thumb|right|The surface of Kuat.]] Kuat City, which hosted many shops, hotels, restaurants, and places of general merchant business, lacked a groundside [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and was accessible by [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. The [[Gardens of Tralala]] were located on Kuat. ==Inhabitants== {{Main|Kuati/Legends}} The [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] were a proud, class-conscious people who considered the ability to trace one's ancestry back to The Ten a trait worthy of pride. Humans comprised 80% of Kuat's population of 3.6 billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. Hundreds of millions of workers lived in the Kuat Drive Yards orbital stardocks, and while most Kuati citizens lived in apartment complexes built into the array, upper-class Kuati resided in vast estates on the planet. Kuati beings who did not live on their world's surface could only access the countryside through Kuat City, while non-Kuati were required to obtain numerous costly permits to visit the surface. Furthermore, the Kuati police reserved the right to refuse entry into the lands to anyone, even those who were able to pay the appropriate fees. Many visitors from offworld remained in the orbital array throughout their trip to the planet. [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Kuat (language)|Kuat]] were languages spoken on the planet. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] was a native of Kuat.{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}} ==Behind the scenes== Kuat has relatively few actual appearances in
